title: Recommendation to approve an appropriation of funds from the Unreserved and Undesignated Fund Balance (UUFB) to the Library Budget Reserve Fund, Library Trust Fund, and Transfer of appropriations within Fund 300.
text:
[Board of Library Commissioners, Exhibit B]
Recommendation to approve an appropriation of funds from the Unreserved and Undesignated Fund Balance (UUFB) to the Library Budget Reserve Fund, Library Trust Fund, and Transfer of appropriations within Fund 300.
summary: The Library commissioners are asked to approve moving unreserved fund balance into the Library Budget Reserve Fund and Library Trust Fund, and to transfer appropriations within Fund 300.

details.action: Appropriate unreserved fund balance and transfer appropriations
